name: Can a clogged vent pipe cause a sewer smell in my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can a clogged vent pipe cause a sewer smell in my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a clogged or blocked vent pipe can absolutely cause a sewer smell in your bathroom. Plumbing vent pipes are crucial for allowing air into the drainage system, which helps wastewater flow efficiently and prevents a vacuum effect. If a vent pipe becomes blocked by debris, nesting animals, or even snow, it can disrupt the system's air pressure. This disruption can siphon water from P-traps, breaking the water seal and allowing sewer gases to escape into your living space, leading to strong odors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a clogged vent pipe can cause sewer smells. It disrupts air pressure in the plumbing system, siphoning water from P-traps and allowing sewer gases to escape.
